event_overview.title: About Multiple Women Accuse Jared Leto of Sexual Misconduct During Teenage Years
event_overview.subject: Multiple Women Accuse Jared Leto of Sexual Misconduct During Teenage Years
event_overview.summary: This event concerns allegations presented in a BBC documentary released on July 29, 2026, in which four women accused actor and musician Jared Leto of sexual misconduct or assault connected to encounters from 2002 to 2016. The allegations are unproven; Leto told the Associated Press that he has never sexually assaulted anyone and that the claims are false.

facts.label: Documentary and release date
facts.value: The allegations were reported in the BBC documentary “Jared Leto: Hollywood’s Dark Secret,” released on July 29, 2026.

facts.label: Locations described
facts.value: Reported allegations include encounters said to have occurred in California and London, among other settings described in coverage of the documentary.

facts.label: Prior public reporting and denial
facts.value: The July 2026 documentary followed a June 7, 2025 Air Mail report in which nine women accused Leto of impropriety; his representative denied those earlier allegations, and Leto personally denied the later allegations to AP.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers the July 29-30, 2026 reporting and immediate response, not a determination of the allegations’ truth or a complete record of earlier claims involving Leto.
